tool.name: Google Agent Identity
tool.description: SPIFFE-based cryptographic identity for agents on Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform, usable as an IAM principal with auto-rotated certs.
tool.practitionerNote: Natural choice for agents on Agent Runtime, Gemini Enterprise or Cloud Run; identities are scoped to Google Cloud, so cross-cloud agents still need a broker or federation.

dataResidency.detail: Agent Identity overview does not state data residency; governed by the hosting Google Cloud resource location.

deployment.detail: Managed Google Cloud service for Agent Runtime, Gemini Enterprise and Cloud Run agents.

auditLogging.detail: Audit logs record actions both when the agent acts as itself and on behalf of an end user.

soc2.detail: Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform and IAM are in scope for Google Cloud SOC 1/2/3 reports.

iso27001.detail: Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform and IAM are in scope for ISO 27001/27017/27018.

iso42001.detail: Google Cloud ISO/IEC 42001 service scope could not be confirmed for Agent Identity.

euAiAct.detail: Identity and access-control tooling for agents, not itself an AI system placed on the market; AI Act obligations rest with the provider/deployer of the governed agents.

licenseRisk.detail: Proprietary Google Cloud service; identities tied to Google Cloud IAM.
